name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Growth Partnerships & Digital Marketing | Partner Programs, Content & Performance
summary: Growth and partnerships marketer with 15+ years building partner programs, content, and the reporting that proves what they return. Recruited, onboarded, and retained a 15-20 partner network at Birdeye with roughly 94% retention, building the training materials and communication workflows that made partners productive. Writes the thought leadership, direct-response copy, and campaign narratives himself, and builds the dashboards that tie engagement and conversion back to revenue. Denver metro based, with early operating experience building compliance systems from scratch in a highly regulated startup.
